title: Implement a range sum segment tree in Rust
description: Implement SegmentTree supporting build from slice, point update, and range sum query.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement SegmentTree in src/lib.rs using a 1-indexed array of size 4*n:
- `new(data)`: store n=data.len(), allocate tree: Vec<i64> of size 4*n zeros, call build(data, 1, 0, n-1)
- `build(node, start, end)`: if start==end set tree[node]=data[start]; else mid=(start+end)/2, recurse left (2*node, start, mid) and right (2*node+1, mid+1, end), tree[node]=tree[2*node]+tree[2*node+1]
- `update(idx, val)`: call update_helper(1, 0, n-1, idx, val)
- `update_helper(node, start, end, idx, val)`: if start==end set tree[node]=val; else recurse into correct half, then tree[node]=tree[2*node]+tree[2*node+1]
- `query(l, r)`: call query_helper(1, 0, n-1, l, r)
- `query_helper(node, start, end, l, r)`: if r<start || end<l return 0; if l<=start && end<=r return tree[node]; else mid=(start+end)/2, return left+right recursions
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
